I'm sorry your parcel NW2002 arrived damaged. Because the declared value is 1,200 EUR, your claim needs to be reviewed by a human agent, and I've escalated it to them.

To help them process it quickly, please send:
- Photos of the parcel
- Photos of the packaging

Please open your claim by 2026-12-06, which is 30 days after the promised delivery date (2026-11-06).

Please note that compensation is the declared value, up to 500 EUR per parcel. Values above 500 EUR require the "Insured Plus" add-on, which covers up to 5,000 EUR. The agent will confirm how this applies to your shipment.
